This issue makes the engine CONSUME it." - name: "rigorix-sdk schemas/policy.json" type: cross-repo note: "The frozen bundle shape ($defs.sequenceRule/stepRequirement)." intent: | Close the policy-distribution loop. Enterprise is the policy **source of truth** and exports a bundle (`rigorix.policy.bundle` / `GET /api/v1/policies/bundle`) whose `sequence_policy` root surface (fail_closed + rules + requirements) mirrors the OSS `SequencePolicyConfig`. Today the OSS engine loads sequence policy **only** from `.rigorix/sequence-policy.toml`; the backend `EnforcementConfigProvider` seam merges only `EnforcementConfig` (budgets/tool_policies) — so an exported bundle never reaches the engine, and "what the org exported" is not proven to equal "what the agent enforces". This issue adds a bundle ingestion path into the engine's sequence-policy repository/config construction, and a conformance round-trip that proves: given the same rules, the engine enforces the bundle **identically** to the equivalent local TOML. That is enterprise C3's AC #6, verified from the OSS side. in_scope: - "A `SequencePolicyConfig` ingestion path from a JSON value matching `schemas/policy.json` v1 (the enterprise export), alongside the existing TOML repository" - "Precedence + trust: define how a locally-present `.rigorix/sequence-policy.toml` interacts with a fetched bundle (source of truth is enterprise; decide and document merge/replace, fail-closed on conflict)" - "Fail-closed parsing: a malformed/over-cap bundle is refused, never silently ignored (mirror the TOML fail-closed behavior + SafetyCaps)" - "`requirements` array round-trips (ADR-015): exported requirement -> parsed StepRequirement -> enforced at plan time (deny/promote, require_identity/require_params)" - "Conformance fixture + test: enterprise export JSON -> engine parse -> evaluate a plan -> identical verdict to the local-TOML equivalent (deny/promote/allow, rule_id + step asserted)" - "Wire the ingestion into composition where sequence policy is built (mcp/main.rs `with_sequence_policy` path and the server composition, once C2 exists)" - "Documentation: sequence-policy module doc + audit/orchestrator note on bundle-sourced policy" out_of_scope: - The enterprise exporter itself (#204/#205 — done) - The catalog method `rigorix.policy.bundle` server implementation (C3) - HMAC verification of the bundle (track separately if the bundle is signed end-to-end; this issue parses + enforces the shape) - Changing rule semantics / adding new rule kinds (this is distribution, not new policy) - Runtime hot-reload of policy (fetch-on-start or explicit refresh only; a refresh protocol is a follow-up) affected_layers: domain: - "Modify: engine/src/sequence_policy/domain/config.rs if a from-value/from-bundle constructor is needed (keep validation shared with TOML)" application: - "Modify: engine/src/sequence_policy/application/service_impl.rs only if the load path needs a new source" infrastructure: - "Create: engine/src/sequence_policy/infrastructure/repository/bundle_repository.rs (or a from_value on the TOML repo)" - "Modify: engine/src/sequence_policy/infrastructure/repository/mod.rs" composition: - "Modify: mcp/src/main.rs (sequence policy construction) and the C2 server composition" tests: - "Create: engine/tests/conformance/policy_bundle.rs (round-trip)" - "Create: fixtures under engine/tests/conformance/fixtures/ (exported bundle)" docs: - "Modify: engine/.pi/architecture/modules/sequence-policy.md" canonical_references: - adr: "engine/.pi/architecture/decisions/ADR-013-sequence-policy.md; ADR-015-operator-step-requirements.md; ADR-014-effect-identity-matching.md" - schema: "rigorix-sdk schemas/policy.json (v1 root: fail_closed + rules + requirements); schemas/envelope.json (requirement_findings)" - code: "engine/src/sequence_policy/domain/config.rs (SequencePolicyConfig, SafetyCaps, validate_retention); engine/src/sequence_policy/infrastructure/repository/toml_repository.rs; engine/src/sequence_policy/domain/requireillement.rs" - code: "engine/src/backend/mod.rs (EnforcementConfigProvider — the existing backend seam that does NOT cover sequence policy); mcp/src/main.rs (sequence policy wiring ~L1521)" - module: "engine/.pi/architecture/modules/sequence-policy.md (R8/R9, configuration); enterprise core/.pi/architecture/modules/execution-api.md (AC #6)" - docs: "rigorix-oss docs/next-workstreams-2026-09-21.md §C5" acceptance_criteria: - "[ ] Engine can build a `SequencePolicyConfig` from the exported bundle JSON (policy.json v1 shape)" - "[ ] `requirements` round-trip: exported requirement is enforced at plan time (deny + promote paths), with `requirement_findings` in the envelope" - "[ ] Conformance round-trip: the same rules as bundle vs local TOML produce identical verdicts (rule_id + step + action asserted) for a denial, a promotion, and an allow" - "[ ] Fail-closed: malformed/over-cap bundle refused (not ignored); SafetyCaps apply to bundle-sourced rules too" - "[ ] Precedence between a local TOML and a fetched bundle is defined + documented; conflicts fail closed" - "[ ] The existing TOML path + all sequence-policy tests remain green (no regression)" - "[ ] `denied_by_sequence` errors from bundle-sourced rules still carry `rule_id` + `step` (server/mcp surfaces)" - "[ ] local-ci 107/107 + CI green; fmt/clippy `-D warnings` clean" validators: - ci - tests - security - architecture - canonical implementation_notes: | - **Reuse the validation.** `SequencePolicyConfig` already validates ids, obligations, pointers, and SafetyCaps. Parse the bundle into the SAME type and reuse that validation — do not add a parallel validator (they will diverge). Code truth for the export is the enterprise `StepRequirementExport` / `SequencePolicySurface` (#204) and the SDK `policy.json $defs`. - **Field names must match code truth.** `match` (serde rename), lowercase `action` (deny|promote), `require_identity`, `require_params`. Verify against `engine/src/sequence_policy/domain/requirement.rs` and `rule.rs` before writing the deserializer; additive fields are serde-defaulted. - **Do not couple to `audit_backend_url` blindly.** The existing backend seam fetches a merged `EnforcementConfig`. Whichever, keep the identity of "enterprise is the source of truth". - **Fail-closed on an absent/empty bundle** mirrors fail-open-absent for the local file: distinguish "no bundle configured" (status quo) from "bundle present but invalid" (refuse). Document the distinction explicitly. - **Conformance fixture provenance**: derive at least one fixture from the real enterprise export shape (with `requirements` + a `sequence` rule using ADR-014 `equals_step`/`effect_key`) so the round-trip exercises R7/R8/R9 together. - If a local TOML and a bundle are both present, the safe default is **enterprise-wins with a logged, tested override**; if that cannot be made unambiguous, refuse to start (fail closed) rather than guess. file_changes: - "create: engine/src/sequence_policy/infrastructure/repository/bundle_repository.rs" - "modify: engine/src/sequence_policy/infrastructure/repository/mod.rs" - "modify: mcp/src/main.rs" - "modify: (server composition when C2 lands)" - "create: engine/tests/conformance/policy_bundle.rs" - "modify: engine/.pi/architecture/modules/sequence-policy.md" pipeline_steps: - implement - validate - create-mr - merge ```
# OSS-C5: Engine consumes an enterprise-exported policy bundle — conformance round-trip ## Intent Close the policy-distribution loop. Enterprise exports the bundle; the OSS engine must **enforce it identically** to an equivalent local config, and prove it. Today the engine loads sequence policy only from `.rigorix/sequence-policy.toml` — the backend `EnforcementConfigProvider` merges only budgets/tool policies — so an exported bundle has no path in. This is enterprise C3's AC #6, verified OSS-side. ## Dependencies ``` rigorix-oss #886 (ADR-015, done) rigorix-enterprise #204/#205 (export, done) │ │ └───────────────┬─────────────────┘ ▼ OSS-C5 bundle ingestion + conformance (THIS ISSUE) │ proves ▼ C3 AC #6: bundle enforced identically to local ``` ## In Scope - Ingest `SequencePolicyConfig` from the exported bundle JSON (policy.json v1). - Precedence + trust vs a local TOML; fail-closed on conflict. - `requirements` round-trip (ADR-015) incl. envelope findings. - Conformance round-trip test: bundle vs local TOML → identical verdicts. - Wire into composition (mcp + C2 server). ## Out of Scope - The enterprise exporter (#204/#205). `rigorix.policy.bundle` server impl (C3). - Bundle HMAC verification (separate if signed end-to-end). New rule semantics. - Runtime hot-reload (fetch-on-start / explicit refresh only). ## Affected Layers ### Domain / Infrastructure - Bundle → `SequencePolicyConfig` path (reuse existing validation + SafetyCaps). ### Composition - `mcp/src/main.rs` sequence-policy wiring; C2 server when it lands. ### Tests - `engine/tests/conformance/policy_bundle.rs` + fixtures. ## Canonical References - **ADRs** ADR-013, ADR-014, ADR-015 - **schema** `rigorix-sdk schemas/policy.json` (v1 root), `envelope.json` - **code** `sequence_policy/domain/{config,requirement,rule}.rs`, `infrastructure/repository/toml_repository.rs`, `backend/mod.rs`, `mcp/src/main.rs` - **backlog** `docs/next-workstreams-2026-09-21.md` §C5; **enterprise** `execution-api.md` AC #6 ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | Config built from exported bundle JSON | unit + fixture | | 2 | `requirements` enforced (deny + promote); envelope findings | conformance | | 3 | Bundle vs local TOML → identical verdicts (deny/promote/allow) | `policy_bundle.rs` | | 4 | Malformed/over-cap bundle refused; SafetyCaps apply | unit | | 5 | Local-vs-bundle precedence defined; conflicts fail closed | review + test | | 6 | Existing TOML path + tests green | full suite | | 7 | `denied_by_sequence` carries `rule_id` + `step` from bundle rules | mcp/server test | | 8 | local-ci + CI green; fmt/clippy `-D warnings` | CI | ## Implementation Notes - **Reuse the validator** — parse into the same `SequencePolicyConfig`; never add a parallel validator. Field names match code truth (`match` rename, lowercase `action`, `require_identity`, `require_params`); additive fields serde-defaulted. - **Sequence policy is a separate config** from `EnforcementConfig`; don't assume the existing backend seam covers it. Decide: extend the provider or add a sibling. - **Absent vs invalid**: "no bundle configured" = status quo; "bundle present but invalid" = refuse. Document explicitly. - **Fixture provenance**: derive one fixture from the real export shape with a `sequence` rule using ADR-014 `equals_step`/`effect_key` **and** a `requirements` entry, so R7/R8/R9 round-trip together. - If local TOML + bundle conflict cannot be made unambiguous, **refuse to start**. ## DoD - [ ] Bundle ingestion + shared validation + fail-closed - [ ] Round-trip conformance green (deny/promote/allow + rule_id/step) - [ ] Composition wired; TOML path unregressed - [ ] Docs updated (sequence-policy module); CI green

Released 1.6.0." intent: | Build the OSS reference execution host: a new workspace crate `server/` (`rigorix-server`) that exposes the frozen `rigorix.*` catalog over HTTP — JSON-RPC 2.0 at `POST /rpc` and SSE at `GET /events` (per C1). It is the single-tenant reference implementation of the same catalog the enterprise Execution API (C3) serves org-scoped, and the first live target for the `rigorix_enterprise_*` proxy seam. It must be a *host*, not a second engine: every method delegates to the same engine facade + orchestrator + approval binding + identity/keychain + audit writer that `rigorix-mcp` uses. Method behavior is identical to the MCP tool counterparts — same DTOs, same error taxonomy (ADR-0001 D6/D9). stdio MCP is unchanged; the legacy MCP SSE path is **not** resurrected (GAP-A-10). in_scope: - "New workspace crate `server/` (binary `rigorix-server`) added to root Cargo.toml members; resurrecting the legacy MCP SSE endpoint (GAP-A-10) - New engine capabilities — the server is a host over the existing engine - Multi-tenant / API-key model (the enterprise half) affected_layers: server: - "create: server/Cargo.toml (binary rigorix-server)" - "create: server/src/main.rs (axum bootstrap, config, graceful shutdown)" - "create: server/src/transport/ (jsonrpc codec: request/response/error, batch)" - "create: server/src/events/ (SSE stream per C1)" - "create: server/src/methods/ (one handler per catalog method, delegating to the facade)" - "create: server/src/auth/ (edge auth + identity claim reuse)" - "create: server/src/error.rs (taxonomy mapping)" workspace: - "modify: Cargo.toml (members += server; shared deps: axum, tower, hyper)" tests: - "create: server/tests/rpc_transport.rs, server/tests/catalog_parity.rs, server/tests/events_sse.rs, server/tests/auth_levels.rs" docs: - "create: server/.pi/architecture/modules/rigorix-server.md (module doc, Guardian format)" - "modify: README.md (workspace layout)" ci: - "modify: .pi/scripts/local-ci.sh / .github/workflows/ci.yml (server crate jobs)" canonical_references: - adr: "rigorix-sdk docs/adr/ADR-0001-native-api-catalog.md — D1 transport, D3 versioning, D4 auth levels, D5 identity invariant, D6 error model, D7 idempotency, D8 push, D9 MCP adapter, D10 non-goals" - schema: "rigorix-sdk schemas/api/catalog.json (methods + $defs), schemas/api/errors.json, schemas/api/events.json (C1)" - docs: "docs/sdk-server-strategy-freeze-2026-09-06.md (D-3/D-4/D-6 + 'what this means for rigorix-oss'); docs/next-workstreams-2026-09-21.md §C2" - code: "mcp/src/execution_tools/, mcp/src/audit_tools/, mcp/src/template_tools/, mcp/src/auth/ (the DTOs + facade the server must match); mcp/src/main.rs (composition)" - code: "mcp/mcp ... enterprise-proxy module — mcp/.pi/architecture/modules/enterprise-proxy.md (the seam this server is the first live target for)" - code: "engine EnterpriseFacade / orchestrator / event system / audit writer" - gap: "engine/.pi/architecture/gap-ledger.md GAP-A-10 (legacy SSE removed — do not resurrect)" - module: "mcp/.pi/architecture/modules/mcp-server.md, execution-tools.md, audit.md, auth.md" acceptance_criteria: - "[ ] New `server/` crate builds; `rigorix-server` binary runs and serves `POST /rpc`" - "[ ] JSON-RPC 2.0 transport: single, batch, notification; HTTP 200 for well-formed envelopes; malformed -> -32700/-32600" - "[ ] Every catalog method (except enterprise `rigorix.policy.bundle`) is served and returns the catalog result schema" - "[ ] Method results are identical to the MCP tool results for the same inputs (parity test over DTOs)" - "[ ] Error taxonomy: each EngineFacadeError maps to a distinct `errors.json` `data.type`; `denied_by_sequence` carries `rule_id` + `step`" - "[ ] Auth levels enforced per catalog entry (public/session/admin); unattested `approve` refused when auth is configured" - "[ ] Identity invariant (D5): display-only identity fields never authorize; policy principal == attested subject" - "[ ] `GET /events` emits the three events per C1; Last-Event-ID replay + heartbeat + backpressure tested" - "[ ] Catalog drift test: MCP tools ↔ catalog methods 1:1; server serves exactly the catalog set; no raw step-execution method exists" - "[ ] `rigorix.system.version` reports engine/api versions + capabilities" - "[ ] `plan → run → approve(if paused) → audit.read` works end-to-end over HTTP (idempotency via `execution_id`, D7)" - "[ ] local-ci 107/107 (or updated count) + CI green; fmt/clippy -D warnings clean" validators: - ci - tests - security - architecture - canonical implementation_notes: | - **Reuse, don't reinvent.** The MCP tool handlers already build the DTOs and call the facade. Extract/share rather than duplicating: the server's method layer should call the same application services. If a needed type is private to `mcp`, lift it into the engine's public surface or a small shared crate — do NOT copy-paste DTOs (they will drift). - **The first HTTP dependency since GAP-A-10.** Choose axum (strategy freeze names it). Keep the transport thin; the catalog is the contract. - **Error mapping is the risky part.** `EngineFacadeError` variants (`mcp/src/execution_tools/domain/error.rs`) must map deterministically to the ADR-0001 D6 table. `denied_by_sequence` MUST carry `rule_id` + `step` — the demos assert those. - **Identity invariant (D5) is a security property.** Authorization uses the attested session (engine `IdentityRef`); caller-supplied identity is display-only. # OSS-C2: `rigorix-server` — OSS reference execution host (axum JSON-RPC + SSE) ## Intent Build the OSS reference execution host for the frozen `rigorix.*` catalog: a new workspace crate `server/` (`rigorix-server`) serving JSON-RPC 2.0 at `POST /rpc` and SSE at `GET /events` (per C1). It is a **host over the existing engine** — it adds no engine capability and must behave identically to the MCP tools. It is the single-tenant reference for the same catalog C3 serves org-scoped. ## Dependencies ``` ADR-0001 catalog freeze (done) C1 SSE spec (rigorix-sdk) │ │ └──────────────┬─────────────────┘ ▼ OSS-C2 rigorix-server (THIS ISSUE) │ reused by ▼ C3 enterprise Execution API (same catalog) ``` - **C1** is normative for `GET /events` — implement it, do not invent. - **Engine/MCP 1.6.0** — the facade + DTOs the server delegates to. ## In Scope - New `server/` crate (axum); `POST /rpc` (single/batch/notification); `GET /events` (SSE). - All 19 catalog methods (except enterprise `rigorix.policy.bundle`). - Auth levels (D4) + identity invariant (D5) reusing the mcp auth module. - Error taxonomy mapping (`errors.json`), `denied_by_sequence` carries `rule_id`+`step`. - `rigorix.system.version`; catalog drift test; MCP↔server parity test. ## Out of Scope - Enterprise org scoping / `rigorix.policy.bundle` / team scope → C3. - MCP Streamable HTTP; the legacy MCP SSE endpoint (GAP-A-10). - Changing stdio MCP; new engine capabilities; multi-tenancy. ## Affected Layers ### New crate `server/` - `main.rs` (axum bootstrap), `transport/` (JSON-RPC codec), `events/` (SSE), `methods/` (per-catalog handlers), `auth/` (edge auth), `error.rs` (taxonomy). ### Workspace / CI / Docs - `Cargo.toml` members += `server`; CI jobs; module doc; README layout. ## Canonical References - **ADR-0001** — D1/D3/D4/D5/D6/D7/D8/D9/D10 - **schemas** `catalog.json`, `errors.json`, `events.json` (C1) - **code** `mcp/src/{execution_tools,audit_tools,template_tools,auth}`, `mcp/src/main.rs` - **seam** `mcp/.pi/architecture/modules/enterprise-proxy.md` - **gap** GAP-A-10 (no legacy SSE) ## Acceptance Criteria | # | Criterion | Verify in | |---|-----------|-----------| | 1 | `server/` builds; `rigorix-server` serves `POST /rpc` | build + smoke | | 2 | Single/batch/notification framing; malformed → -32700/-32600 | `rpc_transport.rs` | | 3 | All 19 methods served (minus enterprise bundle) | `catalog_parity.rs` | | 4 | Server results == MCP tool results (same inputs) | `catalog_parity.rs` | | 5 | Error taxonomy complete; `denied_by_sequence` has `rule_id`+`step` | `error` tests | | 6 | Auth levels enforced; unattested approve refused | `auth_levels.rs` | | 7 | D5 identity invariant holds | `auth_levels.rs` | | 8 | SSE per C1: 3 events, Last-Event-ID, heartbeat, backpressure | `events_sse.rs` | | 9 | Drift test 1:1 MCP↔catalog; no raw step-exec method | drift test | | 10 | `version` reports engine/api + capabilities | unit | | 11 | plan→run→approve→audit.read e2e over HTTP; `execution_id` idempotency | e2e | | 12 | local-ci + CI green; fmt/clippy `-D warnings` | CI | ## Implementation Notes - **Reuse, don't reinvent.** Share the mcp DTOs/facade calls; if a type is private to `mcp`, lift it to the engine public surface or a small shared crate. No copy-pasted DTOs (they drift). - **First HTTP dep since GAP-A-10** — axum; keep transport thin. - **Error mapping is the risk.** Map `EngineFacadeError` → the D6 table; preserve `rule_id`/`step` (demos assert them). - **D5 is a security property** — attested session is authoritative. - **stdio MCP unchanged** — two adapters, one engine. - **`GET /events`** subscribes to the existing event bus; bounded per-session buffer; do not stall execution. - **Config**: reuse `rigorix.toml` / `.rigorix/` loading; no second config file. - Suggested PR split: (a) crate+transport+auth+system; (b) execution methods; (c) audit/template; (d) SSE — each green. ## DoD - [ ] `rigorix-server` serves the full frozen catalog with MCP parity - [ ] Error taxonomy + auth levels + D5 invariant tested - [ ] `GET /events` implements C1 - [ ] No legacy SSE; stdio MCP untouched - [ ] local-ci + CI green; module doc + README updated
